decisions.reason: Changing the HubSpot report format to a simple sales funnel does not alter the deferred direct Sales Navigator-to-HubSpot synchronization requirement.
The reporting-format decision does not change how leads are transferred from HubSpot to MeetAlfred.
A simple sales-funnel report in HubSpot does not change the MeetAlfred campaign creation or Zap setup workflow.
The HubSpot reporting-format decision is unrelated to provisioning the outreach domain.
